alerts.title: Mikuymanta yuyachikkuna
alerts.description: Kaypimi kikinpak wawakunapak kawsak yuyachikkunata rikunki, ashtawan llakimanta kallarishpa.

children.title: Llakipi kak wawakuna
children.description: Kikinwan tinkishka wawakuna, wiñay tupuypi ima llaki kashkamanta ñankuna.

messages.title: Willaykuna, katinakunapash
messages.description: Wawa kamakkunawan rimanakuy, mikuymanta katina yuyaykunatapash killkana.
